title: To establish a supplemental food and nutrition services grant program, and for other purposes.
description: To establish a supplemental food and nutrition services grant program, and for other purposes.
last_action: Referred to the Committee on Agriculture, and in addition to the Committees on Energy and Commerce, and Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
